_doc: Where a canoe's parts come from (user 2026-09-29: 'gathering first so you can build a real boat from scratch'). TreeHarvest reads 'harvest': what E (hold, the list) offers on a standing tree: species it works on, the tool (any of: an 'item.' id is the survival kit's, 'gather:' a gathering tool, else a pack kind), seconds of work, what it gives (pack kinds), and how often one tree can be used (limit; 'peel' is one sheet a tree: a sheet is a big part of it). Pine pitch is not here: it is foraged from the pines' wounds already (data/forage/forage.json). The boat stand reads 'make': parts cut from poles at the stand (from, takes, makes, tool, seconds). Nothing here is a recipe of the survival core: these are the boat builder's own preparation. Pack kinds: data/survival/game_items.json 'materials'.
